welcome.title: Have a quantum idea? Build it here.
welcome.lead: Write Qiskit code, simulate circuits and manage a full hybrid project — classical, quantum and the glue between them. Everything runs in your browser. Nothing to install.

welcome.laneQuantumDesc: Circuits and quantum algorithms, written with Qiskit.
welcome.laneIntegrationDesc: How both sides talk: interfaces, orchestration, data flow and integration tests.
